name: China All-In - Copy for me to understand series - copy
author: Wado321

notes: Start @age/age_2.webp@@landmark_chinese/imperial-academy.webp@with 4 from@resource/resource_food.webp@, then back to @resource/resource_wood.webp@and build @building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@
2 unit ready, make 4th @unit_chinese/imperial-official.webp@ to roam and/or @ability_chinese/supervise.webp@ production buildings
You can go 1:1ish on food-wood a bit, or priotize @resource/resource_food.webp@
Consider @technology_economy/professional-scouts.webp@ can going with 6 @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@ IF have low food reserves

1x @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ build @building_chinese/village.webp@  at 7x  @resource/resource_food.webp@ @resource/rally.webp@ 3x @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ > GOLD + @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@ ( need 225 gold total age up + IO )
Build mill, 7th vill builds village and goes to food
3 food vills build imperial academy, BBQ workers on wood, rally to wood
Move gold vills to wood after having 50 gold for IO
Drop 1st stable. Landmark vills back to food, rally to wood, build IO
After 10 wood vills, rally to stone, make 3rd IO
Drop 1st barracks, make a few spears to protect
Research wheelbarrow, make a few more units
Drop 2nd TC on deer to secure safe food, move 3 food vills to gold + rally to gold (2 vills)
Rally starting TC to wood, 2nd TC to deer
*Around 9:05, you should have this vill allocation on 2 TCs AND units on the map for harass*
Start researching all your eco upgrades (double broadax, forestry, survival techniques, horticulture, acid distillation, imperial examinations)
Build 3-4 archery ranges, start spamming out zhuge nu for a late feudal push or to defend a push, build 4th IO
After 20 on wood, rally both TCs on food. Build blacksmith and start researching upgrades
When you have about 35 vills on food, rally BOTH TCs to wood until about 35
You should have enough to age up, start walling the map. Rally BOTH TCs to gold
Once you are castle, you should have excess gold to start getting your tier 2 eco upgrades, military techs on your zhuge nu and spears, and make monks to get the relics that remain on the map
Once you have 15 on gold, rally both TCs to wood and start working on your farm transition as you'll have exhausted both deer packs, both berry bushes and 1 boar so you need farms
